meta_title: SST Electrical | Domestic & Commercial Electrician Leicester
meta_description: SST Electrical is a trusted Leicester electrician. Domestic and commercial electrical services, same-day repairs, and full installations. Call now for a free quote.
hero_subhead: Electrical fault? We're out to you in under an hour. Domestic rewires, consumer unit upgrades, and fault-finding—all backed by a safety guarantee.
services_heading: Complete Electrical Services Across Leicester & East Midlands
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full rewires, we handle every type of electrical work for homes and businesses.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown circuits, faulty outlets, and tripped electrics fixed fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to get power restored the same day.

services.title: Domestic Rewires
services.desc: Full rewires for older homes using modern cable and safety standards. Includes new consumer unit installation and testing certification.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Replace outdated fuse boxes with modern RCD-protected units. Improves safety and lets you run more appliances without overload.

services.title: Commercial Electrical Installation
services.desc: Lighting, power distribution, and fire safety systems for shops, offices, and warehouses. All work certified and compliant with building regulations.

services.title: Fault Finding & Testing
services.desc: Can't find an electrical fault? We diagnose and fix hidden problems using specialist test equipment. Full reports provided.

services.title: EV Charging Point Installation
services.desc: Wall-mounted home and workplace charging stations fitted by certified installers. Grant-funded options available.

about_pullquote: I started SST because too many Leicester homes were left without power at night.
about_para_1: SST Electrical was founded 18 years ago on one simple idea: Leicester homeowners and businesses deserve an electrician who answers the phone at midnight and shows up fast. Since then, we've built a reputation for honest pricing, first-time fixes, and work that passes every inspection. We're NICEIC registered, fully insured, and every job comes with certification.
about_para_2: Our customers keep coming back because we don't charge a call-out fee, we don't disappear mid-job, and we stand behind every repair. From a leaking geyser fault to a full commercial rewire, we treat your property with the same care we'd give our own. That's why 92% of our work comes from repeat customers and personal referrals.

reviews.text: Boiler tripped electrics at 11pm on a Saturday. Called SST and they were here by midnight. Sorted it in 20 minutes, no call-out charge. Top lads. Will use them for everything now.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.text: Had my whole house rewired by SST. Professional job from start to finish. They explained everything, tidied up after themselves, and provided all the certification. Fair price, no surprises. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: Christine H.

reviews.text: Commercial job for our office. SST installed new lighting and upgraded the consumer unit. Work was on schedule, they understood our downtime needs, and the team were respectful. Great communication throughout.
reviews.author: David L.
